title: August and the Protocol
author: Theo Thornbury
blurb: Yara Eastwick, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent ten years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
